about: The inactive rule (2026-11-10: an agent goes inactive only once you have opened its chat and not followed up, or after 2 days; otherwise it is just read) on the attention mock (`AGENT_IDE_MOCK=attention python3 ../workspace/server.py --port 4391`), started fresh for each run, at 1440x900 with ?tick=1&minimap=inline. A main session whose turn ended with the agent's answer and that you have not read never goes inactive: it keeps its full column, its finished entry on the list (its mark in the column's logo's place) and its row in the mini-map, past ten minutes and past the mini-map's hour. Once you read it (here a click on its column), the ten minutes count from the read: it folds to a stub ten minutes after. Past 48 hours of quiet, unread or not, it is inactive (and the archive stack takes it). The page's clock is moved forward with `clock` steps (window.__clock, mock floors only), so nothing waits out real minutes; each step waits on the page's own state (`idle`: each column under the rule).

actions.note: the finished entry is on the engine's list (its mark takes the column's logo's place)

actions.log: the PR session answered about eleven minutes before the server started, the RCP-142 session about a minute before; nobody has read either
ten minutes on: both answers are past ten minutes unread; both stand as full columns with their finished marks

assert.attention.logosOff: RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off

actions.note: nine minutes after the read: still standing (its last activity is far older, the read is what counts)

assert.!stubs: RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off
assert.attention.logosOff: RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off

actions.note: the camera flew to the PR column: the RCP-142 entry is on the engine's list while its column is off screen (an edge mark), so it is read from the list's agents

actions.note: the mini-map redraws on its own tick

actions.log: 48 hours of quiet: inactive though unread; its finished entry leaves the list (the archive stack takes it off the floor)

assert.stubs: RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off
assert.!attention.logosOff: RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off
